smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: mnml.ai
shortDescription: Turns a floor plan photo into a furnished 2D or 3D view. Lite is $29 a month.
longDescription: mnml.ai Floor Plan AI takes a PDF, a CAD screenshot, or a photo of a 2D plan and returns a colored plan or a furnished 3D view. The walls stay as drawn. Sketch to Image does the same from a hand sketch. Lite is $29 a month for 1,000 credits, Plus is $49, and Studio is $119. A one-time pack is $149 for 10,000 credits. New accounts get 100 credits and no card is required.
pricingNotes: Lite is $29 per month for 1,000 credits. Plus is $49 per month for 3,000 credits. Studio is $119 per month for 10,000 credits. A one-time pack is $149 for 10,000 credits. New accounts get 100 credits with no card.
freeTierNotes: 100 credits on signup. No card required.
